statement: Over Q, with exactly the formal qMZV algebra, quasi-shuffle ideal I, anti-involution tau, weight filtration, and q-series map frozen in source.md and problem.md, every a in W_8 H^0 satisfying Z(a)=0 belongs to I. Equivalently, ker(bar Z restricted to W_8 Z_f^*) is zero.
contribution: A computer-assisted exact proof of the full frozen weight-at-most-eight assertion. An explicit 1432-dimensional subspace of the duality ideal and 165 exact q-coefficient functionals saturate the 1597-dimensional domain by rank-nullity. Nonzero modular minors over two primes certify both rank lower bounds; no conditional dimension formula or finite rank-deficiency inference is used. This makes no claim for weights above eight or for exhaustive priority beyond the scoped literature check in problem.md.
